items.prompt: A clean sanitizer run and a sleep were used to claim a borrowed-reference worker is safe. What evidence is missing?
items.modelAnswer: Need object owner/lifetime through all worker paths, exact conflicting access analysis and specified publication/completion/synchronization ordering. Sleep is not a happens-before guarantee; a clean dynamic detector covers only executed instrumented paths. Prove join/stop/error lifetime handling separately from bounded completion and performance.

criteria.text: Names ownership/lifetime and all relevant accesses.
Rejects sleep/clean run as a universal proof.
